description: Create, update or destroy a reverse_proxy location entry in SOPHOS UTM.

parameters.name: access_control
parameters.description: Whether to activate the access control for the location. Choices: "0" ← (default) "1"

parameters.name: allowed_networks
parameters.description: A list of allowed networks. Default: ["REF_NetworkAny"]

parameters.name: auth_profile
parameters.description: The reference name of the auth profile. Default: ""

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: A list of backends that are connected with this location declaration. Default: []

parameters.name: be_path
parameters.description: The path of the backend. Default: ""

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: The optional comment string. Default: ""

parameters.name: denied_networks
parameters.description: A list of denied network references. Default: []

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules. Default: {}

parameters.name: hot_standby
parameters.description: Activate hot standby mode. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path of the location. Default: "/"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of the object. present creates or updates an object. absent deletes an object if present. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Whether the location is active or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: stickysession_id
parameters.description: The stickysession ID. Default: "ROUTEID"

parameters.name: stickysession_status
parameters.description: Enable the stickysession. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: utm_host
parameters.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: utm_port
parameters.description: The port of the REST interface. Default: 4444

parameters.name: utm_protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_token
parameters.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en, Chapter 2.4.2.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether the REST interface’s SSL certificate should be verified or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: websocket_passthrough
parameters.description: Enable the websocket passthrough. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Create UTM proxy_location
  utm_proxy_backend:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestLocationEntry
    backend: REF_OBJECT_STRING
    state: present

- name: Remove UTM proxy_location
  utm_proxy_backend:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestLocationEntry
    state: absent

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: The utm object that was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: _locked
return_values.description: Whether or not the object is currently locked. Returned: success

return_values.name: _ref
return_values.description: The reference name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: _type
return_values.description: The type of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: access_control
return_values.description: Whether to use access control state. Returned: success

return_values.name: allowed_networks
return_values.description: List of allowed network reference names. Returned: success

return_values.name: auth_profile
return_values.description: The auth profile reference name. Returned: success

return_values.name: backend
return_values.description: The backend reference name. Returned: success

return_values.name: denied_networks
return_values.description: The list of the denied network names. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Whether the object is active or not. Returned: success

return_values.name: stickysession_id
return_values.description: The identifier of the stickysession. Returned: success

return_values.name: stickysession_status
return_values.description: Whether to use stickysession or not. Returned: success

return_values.name: websocket_passthrough
return_values.description: Whether websocket passthrough is used or not. Returned: success
